edits.text: Defendant’s Amended Responses to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production — DRAFT FOR COUNSEL REVIEW

PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant provides the following request-specific responses. Each response will identify any objection, its specific basis and scope, whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis, and the scope of production. Bracketed items require verification and completion before service.

1. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES. [Repeat the following for every request, inserting its actual text.] REQUEST NO. [NUMBER]: [Verbatim request.] RESPONSE: [State whether production will be made as requested. If objecting, identify the particular language or category challenged, the specific grounds and supporting facts, and the extent to which the request will nevertheless be answered.] WITHHOLDING: [State expressly whether responsive materials are being withheld on each stated objection and describe the affected category without revealing privileged information.] PRODUCTION: [Identify the responsive categories to be produced, any agreed limits, and any responsive materials previously produced by production identifiers. If no responsive materials were located after reasonable inquiry, state that only after verification.]

2. SEARCH, PRESERVATION, AND PRODUCTION SCHEDULE. [After verification, describe the reasonable search undertaken, including relevant custodians, repositories, date ranges, and search methods; identify material limitations and their basis.] [After verification, describe reasonable preservation measures taken for potentially relevant documents and electronically stored information, including suspension of routine deletion where appropriate.] Defendant will complete production of responsive, nonprivileged materials within the stated scope by [CONFIRMED MONTH, DAY, YEAR]. [Identify any staged production dates and any categories requiring further agreement or court resolution.]

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. Defendant proposes to provide a privilege log by [PROPOSED MONTH, DAY, YEAR—CONFIRM BEFORE SERVICE]. For each withheld document or permitted grouping, the log will identify the applicable request, date, document type, author or sender, recipients and their relevant roles, privilege or protection asserted, and a description of the subject matter and basis for the claim sufficient to permit assessment without disclosing protected information. Any categorical logging, exclusions, or alternative procedures will be identified and subject to applicable rules, court order, or agreement.

4. SUPPLEMENTATION AND DISPUTES. Defendant will supplement these responses as required by applicable rules or court order. This provision does not enlarge any request-specific objection or postpone an applicable production deadline. The parties reserve their respective rights concerning objections, the adequacy of searches and production, and privilege claims.

delivered.body: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production. 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged material. 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents. 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on privilege grounds, Defendant will provide a privilege log as required by applicable rules or agreement of the parties. 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement this response.
